description: Use when an agent needs the full detail of a single market by its composite key (source + market_id). Returns the market with its parent event reference, current probability, volume, 24h delta, and historical chart points. Includes a `_meta.cite_as` field that the agent can drop directly into its reply.

market_id.description: Market ID native to the source. Composite key with `source`.
market_id.title: Market Id

source.description: Platform ID: polymarket / kalshi / manifold / myriad / limitless / predict / opinion / gemini.
source.title: Source

name: get_market
title: Get a market
